names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Ηλιού Μουρόμας ο Θαυματουργός «ὁ ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ»», with the rank word, the place and the by-names left off. The page prints the name as «Ηλιού» and glosses it under the heading «ΗΛΙΑΣ», «(εβραϊκή λέξη από το ελίγια) = αυτός που έχει θεία δύναμη, ο θείος»; the form on the calendar line is the one stored.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Ηλιού Μουρόμας ο Θαυματουργός «ὁ ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ»»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. **The whole of the page's text is one sentence: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Ρώσου Οσίου.»** That is a refusal to tell the life and not a refusal to vouch for the man: no asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου…». There is no year anywhere on the page, not even in the head, so there is no `dates` object. `types` carries `venerable` and `wonderworker`, which the calendar line's own words give — «Όσιος» and «ο Θαυματουργός»; the further by-name «ὁ ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ», of the Cave, is recorded here and is not asserted as an office or a see. It names Murom and no coordinate is proposed; it prints no hymn. The `russian` row is left `undocumented` although the page calls him a Russian venerable, because days.pravoslavie.ru was not read. The corpus keeps nine folders of Murom — among them `peter-of-murom`, `fevronia-of-murom` and `juliana-of-lazarevo` — and none of them is this man.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
